overview_description.description: Hoods is a social networking platform that enables users to interact through location-based communities and live digital experiences. The platform combines real-time communication, user-generated content, and community engagement features to support local discovery and online interaction. It is designed for individuals and groups to connect around shared interests, events, and neighborhood activities through mobile and web-based access.

product.name: Hoods Live Shopping Application
product.description: A mobile app that enables users to watch live streaming videos showcasing products, interact with brands via chat, and purchase products instantly during the live stream.

product.name: Hoods Talents Community
product.description: A platform within the app where content creators can produce video content, tag products, and earn money by promoting and selling those products to their audience.

product.name: Live Streaming for Brands
product.description: A service that allows brands to add live streaming capabilities to their product presentations, enabling direct engagement and interaction with customers during broadcasts.

product.name: Video Product Reviews with Earning
product.description: A feature that allows users to create video reviews of products they have purchased and earn money based on their reviews and sales generated.
